Title: A card game API
Description: I'm currently working on an API to make it easier to implement multiplayer card games, because otherwise I can only make card games that play with open cards.

Title: A pixel drawing tool
Description: I plan to add a pixel drawing tool to this site, because it would fit the style of this site and I frequently use them and want one I can trust.

Title: Zine Site?
Description:

Title: Have a great Idea?
Description:
If YOU have a great idea for a tool, a toy or a page, that you think I should make, feel free to send me an email!

As mentioned I do my best work in C#/.Net, so it should be compatible with that.
